assertions.evidence: In `routeLead`, the checks `if (lead.headcount > 1000)` and `if (new Set(lead.regions).size >= 3)` return enterprise before the `fetch` to the Decisions API is reached.
The code POSTs to "https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions" with `model: MODEL`, where `const MODEL = "typesafe/jev-1.13"` is a versioned model ID.
The request body's state is only `{ looking_for: lead.lookingFor }`, commented "Send only the unstructured field Jev needs to judge", with no headcount or region data.
